subject: Marketplace ledger harmonization & VAT tranche collection plan
messages:
From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
To: billing+recon@cloudscale.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 09:06:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace ledger harmonization & VAT tranche collection plan

Hi Elena / CloudScale billing team,

We are reconciling marketplace payouts and found a ~$47k delta across AWS and Azure metered lines for Sep/Oct. Attached is a side-by-side workbook (redwood_aws_azure_meter_gap.xlsx) that highlights:
- duplicated metering lines from the Azure listing (entity mapping mismatch)
- two AWS SKUs that were billed under a legacy merchant id
- VAT tagging differences between EU invoices (CloudScale shows VAT at partner level; our ledger expects VAT at seller level)

Request: can you confirm receipt of the attached export and share your consumption export for Oct so we can align ledger lines? We need this reconciled for month-end cutoffs and to decide the collection vs. credit tranche approach.

Desired timeline: initial confirmation today, shared exports by EOD Tuesday, proposed mutual action plan (MAP) by Friday.

Attachments: redwood_aws_azure_meter_gap.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Marketplace Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

---

Note: internal participants only (marissa, laura) are looped for collection history and VAT splits.

From: Elena Novak <billing+recon@cloudscale.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: nadia.karim@globapps.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 11:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Marketplace ledger harmonization & VAT tranche collection plan

Hi Sergio — thanks for the write-up and the workbook. We pulled the Oct metering and I’m attaching our raw consumption export so you can do a direct line-match.

Quick notes from our side:
- The duplicated Azure lines are coming from a nested listing we onboarded in June; that listing sends usage to the reseller entity by default. We can provide a remapping export, but it will require an audit on our side to change the merchant mapping back to the seller-level.
- For the two AWS SKUs, we have one legacy mapping that was grandfathered into the Consolidated Merchant pool — we’ll extract the invoices and provide the invoice IDs.
- VAT: we calculate VAT at the invoice generation stage based on the buyer country and the tax profile passed. If you can map the seller tax IDs you expect, we’ll confirm whether our VAT calc matches.

Attached: cloudscale_consumption_export.csv (CSV)

I can join a quick sync tomorrow to walk through the CSV if helpful.

Best,
Elena Novak
Senior Billing Manager, CloudScale Inc.
billing+recon@cloudscale.com

Forwarded attachment: cloudscale_consumption_export.csv

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace ledger harmonization & VAT tranche collection plan

Looping in more context from collections: we attempted three collection outreaches for the legacy AWS invoice (INV-9921) and netted partial payment of $12,400 on 2028-10-21. Collection attempts are in the attached log.

Proposed split for the remaining gap:
- Apply immediate credit memo for the confirmed duplicated Azure lines (estimate $18,500)
- Hold a tranche of disputed AWS/legacy lines (estimate $16,100) while CloudScale runs mapping audit
- Assign Karthik to own the routing change request for the Azure nested listing (he’ll need the mapping file)

I recommend we avoid write-offs until CloudScale validates remapping; we should hold a canary credit for impacted buyers to preserve accounting reversibility.

Attachments: collection_attempts_log.pdf

-Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks Elena / Nadia — appreciate the quick export. Karthik, can you own the mapping change for Azure nested listing and liaise with CloudScale on the merchant remap? Laura, please prepare a draft credit memo for the duplicated lines we can issue once CloudScale confirms the remap.

I’ll propose a MAP here (attached) with concrete owners and deadlines:
- Nov 6: CloudScale provides remap manifest and invoice IDs for legacy AWS SKUs (Elena)
- Nov 8: Karthik validates mapping and submits change request (Karthik)
- Nov 9: Laura finalizes credit memo draft and routes for sign-off (Laura)
- Nov 13: Issue credit memos for confirmed duplicates; hold tranche on disputed legacy lines pending final invoice proofs

Attachments: MAP_tranche_timeline.csv (mutual action plan)

Sergio

Quick update after final call with CloudScale: they confirmed the merchant remap for the Azure nested listing and provided invoice proofs for the two AWS SKUs. CloudScale will issue an internal billing adjustment and send us a confirmation file by EOD Thursday.

Next steps (confirming Sergio's MAP):
- We will issue a credit memo for $18,475 for the duplicated Azure lines once we receive CloudScale's remap confirmation (Laura to draft).

- Collections to continue outreach on the partially paid invoice; Marissa to update ledger with partial payment and open cash-application ticket if additional funds post.
